title: UNE Document ChangeSet Request
description:
Atomic edit request for UNE-DOC-006 (POST /documents/{documentId}/changesets) and the delta of UNE-DOC-009 (autosaves). A ChangeSet is the ONLY way a document changes (design 07 §1.9): either every operation applies and a new revision exists, or nothing happened. Corrections are new ChangeSets — an applied one is never rewritten (CLAUDE.md: never overwrite audit history). The vocabularies here are the same values as packages/domain/src/document/{change-set,selection}.ts; that file is the runtime source of truth and this schema is its wire contract.

Composition note (ADR-24 D4): this document never combines `allOf` with `additionalProperties:false`. Under JSON Schema 2020-12 a branch carrying `additionalProperties:false` cannot see properties declared in a sibling branch, so such a combination rejects every instance. Shared shapes are therefore inlined, and `allOf` is used only for if/then constraints that add `required` without adding properties.

baseRevisionId.description: Revision the client edited against. Optimistic-concurrency partner of the If-Match header (ADR-30 D4): If-Match carries that revision's revision_no and the two must agree, or the request contradicts itself (422 DOC-422-004).

operations.description: Applied in `order`; the inverse set applies in reverse.

clientMutationId.description: Idempotency anchor for retried submissions, unique within the document (uk_change_set_mutation). Same id + same payload replays the original receipt; same id + different payload is 409 COM-0409.

dryRun.description: Build the diff and validate, but create no revision (US-PLAN-017 AC-01: the document does not move before the user approves the Diff). No change_set/change_operation row is written either — a preview leaves no trace.

undoesChangeSetId.description: Undo lineage (change_set.undoes_change_set_id). Undo is a NEW ChangeSet, so the edge is what makes Redo targeting and UNDO_CONFLICT detection queryable instead of memory-resident.

checkpointLabel.description: Version-history checkpoint label (US-PLAN-020 #3/A-02). Deliberately not an enum: the canon lists 생성전/목차확정/초안완료/수동 checkpoint in one place and 목차확정/본문완료/최종저장 in another, so the set is not closed.

changeSummary.description: Human-readable summary shown in version history. Free prose — never a query predicate (that is what `origin` is for).

changeSetOrigin.description: Where the edit came from. Undo/Redo do NOT get a separate stack (§1.9 keeps AI and user edits in one stack), so origin is the audit and display axis rather than a stack selector.

changeOperationType.description: The eight operations design 07 §1.9 fixes. This list does not grow without an ADR: executor, inverse generator, diff and audit all switch on it exhaustively, and change_operation carries ck_change_operation_type with exactly these values.

offset.description: UTF-16 code unit index into the paragraph's concatenated run text (§1.8, fixed for parity with JavaScript string indexing). The offset space is defined by OFFSET_CONTRIBUTING_ELEMENTS / OFFSET_TRANSPARENT_ELEMENTS in packages/domain/src/document/selection.ts — a client that counts differently edits at the wrong position.

selectionEnvelope.description: What the client sends. It has NO field for pixel/visual coordinates and NO field for a raw XML anchor (§1.8-4): the selection layer is L3 (node id + character offset) and must never reference L1 (partPath#el[n]). Each branch is written out in full rather than composed with allOf, so `additionalProperties:false` stays meaningful.

blockAnchor.description: Placement expressed against STABLE IDS, never against a raw XML anchor — an authored node has no anchor at all (ADR-30 D3).

insertSource.description: Where new blocks come from. GENERATED_BLOCKS is the materialize path (ADR-27 D2 assigned generated_block → document materialize to CC-150): modelled as a SOURCE of INSERT_BLOCKS rather than a ninth operation, so the §1.9 vocabulary stays closed.

oneOf.description: Materialize generated_block rows into the document. Server-side defence is threefold (ADR-27 D4 carried over): the plan's current_toc_version_id must equal tocVersionId (fail-closed otherwise), only rows with superseded_at IS NULL are read, and rows whose protection_state is not NONE are excluded with a reason reported back — never silently.

order.description: Position within the ChangeSet, unique per set (uk_change_operation_order). Where order is the meaning, uniqueness is correctness rather than performance: duplicate orders make application non-deterministic and break invert∘apply == identity (ADR-30 D6).

payload.description: Operation-specific arguments. Left open on purpose: the eight types have genuinely different shapes, and the per-type required arguments are pinned by the if/then rules below rather than by eight parallel object definitions.

allOf.description: INSERT_BLOCKS needs a placement and a source.
MERGE_PARAGRAPHS is expressed by ids, not by a range: the two paragraphs need not be adjacent in the selection the user made.

APPLY_STYLE_ROLE names a ROLE; §1.9 forbids setting styleId directly, because the prototype — not the caller — decides which style id a role resolves to. The ban is scoped to this operation so it mirrors the executor exactly.
